summary: Profile card for speakers and mentors: gradient top band, large overlapping avatar, name (optionally a link covering the whole card), role, tags, a row of stats formatted with Intl and actions such as “Segui”.
whenToUse: Grids of featured speakers, mentors, authors or members on a community page.
Profile preview with a few key figures (talks, followers, articles).
whenNotToUse: Long or compact lists of people: use a list with Avatar or a table.
Rankings with position and score: use RankingCard or Leaderboard.
Just the person's image: use Avatar.

props.name: name
props.description: Person's name: card title, avatar initials and accessible name of the article.

props.name: jobTitle
props.description: Role or title (e.g. “AI Engineer”). It is not called role to avoid shadowing the ARIA attribute.

props.name: company
props.description: Company or organization, shown after the role.

props.name: href
props.description: Profile URL: the name becomes a link whose clickable area covers the whole card.

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: Avatar image; if missing or it fails to load, the initials remain.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Custom avatar instead of the default one.

props.name: stats
props.description: Short figures; numbers are formatted with Intl according to the locale (e.g. compact notation).

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions (e.g. a “Segui” Button): they stay clickable above the stretched link.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Renders a SkeletonProfile of the same shape in its place (aria-busy, hidden non-live “Caricamento…” text) while keeping className and style, so it stays in the grid. Wrap the area in SkeletonGroup for a single announcement.

inherits: HTML attributes of <article> (id, style, data-*, aria-*).

keyboard.action: Reaches the name link (if href) and then the actions.

accessibility: The card is an <article> whose accessible name comes from the title (aria-labelledby).
With href there is a single link (the name): the clickable area is extended with a pseudo-element, so screen readers don't hear duplicate links; focus draws the ring around the whole card.
The avatar is decorative because the name is already visible; the gradient band is aria-hidden.
Stats are a description list (<dl>): label in <dt>, value in <dd>, even though the value is visually above.
In forced-colors mode borders use CanvasText; with prefers-reduced-motion hover does not move the card.
responsive: Centered column layout: works from 320px; tags, stats and actions wrap.
Use Grid with minItemWidth (≈14rem) for a speaker grid.
customization: Tokens: --dc-gradient-accent / --dc-gradient-accent-subtle for the band, --dc-look-radius-container, --dc-look-shadow-primary on hover.
commonMistakes: Wrapping the whole card in an <a>: the inner actions would become nested interactive elements. Use href.
Formatting numbers by hand (“2.1K”): pass the number and formatOptions { notation: "compact" }.
Passing a non-decorative avatar: the name would be read twice.

Actions are designed for one or two buttons: with many items the card grows taller.
